worn_dirk.name: Worn Dirk
worn_dirk.desc: A nicked blade that has seen kinder years. Still sharp enough.

ashblade.name: Ashblade
ashblade.desc: Forged in hearth-cinder. The edge holds a faint ember glow.

thornbow.name: Thornbow
thornbow.desc: Bent moonwood strung with wolf-gut. Prefers distance.

cinder_rod.name: Cinder Rod
cinder_rod.desc: A charred staff capped with a smoldering geode.

hide_vest.name: Hide Vest
hide_vest.desc: Gloom-wolf hide, boiled and laced. Quiet when you walk.

ironband_mail.name: Ironband Mail
ironband_mail.desc: Overlapping iron rings darkened with pitch.

dusk_cloak.name: Dusk Cloak
dusk_cloak.desc: A moth-eaten mantle that drinks torchlight.

ember_charm.name: Ember Charm
ember_charm.desc: A coal that never cools, hung on braided gut.

moss_charm.name: Moss Charm
moss_charm.desc: River-moss bound around a river stone. Steadies the breath.

hearth_charm.name: Hearth Charm
hearth_charm.desc: A splinter of the Hollow's first fire.

emberwood.name: Emberwood
emberwood.desc: Warm to the touch even when dead. Smells of resin and dusk.

moonbloom.name: Moonbloom
moonbloom.desc: Pale petals that open only in the Hollow's long dusk.

imp_cinder.name: Imp Cinder
imp_cinder.desc: A thumb of slag that sparks if squeezed.

iron_shard.name: Iron Shard
iron_shard.desc: A flake of the old veins under Emberfen.

hearthbread.name: Hearthbread
hearthbread.desc: Dense, spiced, still a little warm. Restores 28 health.

moontea.name: Moontea
moontea.desc: Bitter silver brew. Restores 18 health and steadies the hand.

cinder_salve.name: Cinder Salve
cinder_salve.desc: A tin of glowing paste. Restores 52 health.

ember_coin.name: Ember Coin
ember_coin.desc: Copper discs stamped with a closed eye. The Hollow's only coin.

tutor_note.name: Maera's Note
tutor_note.desc: Walk. Gather. Hunt. Trade. The Hollow remembers those who share.

stag_antler.name: Hollow Antler
stag_antler.desc: A rare tine from the Hollow Stag. The forest leans toward you.

cool_down.name: The Cool Down
cool_down.desc: Signature vanilla-mint shake from The Shake Bar, 2545 E Hwy 50. Best-seller.

creamy_dream.name: Creamy Dream
creamy_dream.desc: Oreo milkshake from The Shake Bar. Cookies all the way down.

biscoff_max.name: Biscoff Max
biscoff_max.desc: Cookie-butter shake from The Shake Bar.

coco_loco.name: CoCo-Loco
coco_loco.desc: Coconut-chocolate shake. Slightly unhinged, in a helpful way.

diner_vanilla.name: Diner Vanilla
diner_vanilla.desc: Steak n Shake vanilla. Same lot as The Shake Bar.

diner_chocolate.name: Diner Chocolate
diner_chocolate.desc: Steak n Shake chocolate diner shake.

black_white_shake.name: Black & White
black_white_shake.desc: Steak n Shake black-and-white diner shake.

birthday_cake_scoop.name: Birthday Cake Scoop
birthday_cake_scoop.desc: Bruster's Building H. Sprinkles for morale.

bacon_milkshake.name: Bacon Milkshake
bacon_milkshake.desc: Five Guys custom shake, 1600 N Hancock Rd. A dare in a cup.

peanut_butter_shake.name: Peanut Butter Shake
peanut_butter_shake.desc: Five Guys. The hug, not the dare.

moment_31.name: 31 Moment
moment_31.desc: Mystery scoop. Tess will not name the flavor.

butterscotch_concrete.name: Butterscotch Concrete
butterscotch_concrete.desc: Culver's, 1431 Johns Lake Rd. Eat it upside down.

oreo_blizzard.name: Oreo Blizzard
oreo_blizzard.desc: Dairy Queen, 860 US Hwy 27 (34714). They will flip it.

reeses_blizzard.name: Reese's Blizzard
reeses_blizzard.desc: DQ Blizzard. Peanut butter cups in a snowstorm.

m_chocolate_shake.name: Window Chocolate Shake
m_chocolate_shake.desc: McDonald's Clermont. Machine is, for once, on.

chocolate_frosty.name: Chocolate Frosty
chocolate_frosty.desc: Wendy's Clermont. Spoon or straw, we do not take sides.

vanilla_frosty.name: Vanilla Frosty
vanilla_frosty.desc: Wendy's vanilla Frosty. A little speed in the slush.

moon_berry.name: Moon Berry
moon_berry.desc: Wilds berry that only looks silver at dusk.

walker_jaw.name: Walker Jaw
walker_jaw.desc: Hinged bone that still tries to close. Binding material. Don't keep it in your mouth.

hound_pelt.name: Hound Pelt
hound_pelt.desc: Cinder-stiff fur. Smells like a road flare that learned to hunt.

crawler_ichor.name: Crawler Ichor
crawler_ichor.desc: Mine-dark syrup. Binding reagent. Do not drink. Lila will be tedious.

crowbar.name: Crowbar
crowbar.desc: Zomboid classic. Doorways, jaws, locks. Ugly lasts.

nail_bat.name: Nail Bat
nail_bat.desc: Tavi's thesis in wood and iron. Slow, mean, doorway-legal.

thug_wraps.name: Thug Wraps
thug_wraps.desc: Tape and bad decisions. Fast hands. The strip's favorite argument.

canned_beans.name: Canned Beans
canned_beans.desc: Dent in the tin, still sealed. A hot meal if you can open it.

canned_soup.name: Canned Soup
canned_soup.desc: Chicken-ish. The label peeled off in the humidity.

canned_tuna.name: Canned Tuna
canned_tuna.desc: Oil-packed. The cat that lived here would have killed for it.

canned_peaches.name: Canned Peaches
canned_peaches.desc: Syrup-sweet. A little too intimate for a roadside tin.

dry_cereal.name: Dry Cereal
dry_cereal.desc: Sugar dust and stale corn. Better than an empty stomach.

stale_chips.name: Stale Chips
stale_chips.desc: The bag still puffs. The crunch does not.

chocolate_bar.name: Chocolate Bar
chocolate_bar.desc: Soft from the Florida dusk. Morale in foil.

bottled_water.name: Bottled Water
bottled_water.desc: Warm plastic, honest water. Do not ask where the ice went.

soda_can.name: Soda Can
soda_can.desc: Fizz like a dare. Sugar does the rest.

whiskey_flask.name: Whiskey Flask
whiskey_flask.desc: Someone's courage, half gone. Burns going down, burns coming back.

instant_noodles.name: Instant Noodles
instant_noodles.desc: Brick of salt and hope. Tastes like a night shift.

peanut_butter_jar.name: Peanut Butter
peanut_butter_jar.desc: A spoon is a luxury. A finger will do.

crisp_apple.name: Crisp Apple
crisp_apple.desc: Still has a blush. The tree out back is less lucky.

rotten_apple.name: Rotten Apple
rotten_apple.desc: You could eat it. You should not.

energy_bar.name: Energy Bar
energy_bar.desc: Glue, oats, and a promise of cardio.

leftover_pizza.name: Leftover Pizza
leftover_pizza.desc: Cold slice from a fridge that died mid-hum. Still a little greasy, still a little kind.

coffee_tin.name: Coffee Tin
coffee_tin.desc: Grounds that remember morning. Bitter enough to keep you upright.

dried_jerky.name: Dried Jerky
dried_jerky.desc: Meat that gave up water and kept the attitude.

trail_mix.name: Trail Mix
trail_mix.desc: Nuts, chocolate, and the one raisin nobody wanted.

rice_sack.name: Rice Sack
rice_sack.desc: Dry, honest, heavy. A week of quiet meals if you have a pot.

cooking_oil.name: Cooking Oil
cooking_oil.desc: Greasy bottle. Useful, slippery, a little dangerous.

dusk_mushroom.name: Dusk Mushroom
dusk_mushroom.desc: Forest floor, after the neon fades. Earthy and a little rude.

kitchen_knife.name: Kitchen Knife
kitchen_knife.desc: A chef's knife that learned a second job.

baseball_bat.name: Baseball Bat
baseball_bat.desc: Pine, taped grip, a name in marker that you should not read aloud.

fire_axe.name: Fire Axe
fire_axe.desc: Red head, scuffed handle. Meant for doors. The dusk is full of doors.

claw_hammer.name: Claw Hammer
claw_hammer.desc: A toolbox regular with a mean follow-through.

frying_pan.name: Frying Pan
frying_pan.desc: Cast iron. Breakfast, then self-defense, then breakfast again.

lead_pipe.name: Lead Pipe
lead_pipe.desc: Heavy, ugly, honest. The plumbing gave up first.

machete.name: Machete
machete.desc: Yard-work steel with a smile too wide.

nightstick.name: Nightstick
nightstick.desc: Polymer and bad memories. Short, fast, unkind.

garden_shears.name: Garden Shears
garden_shears.desc: Two blades that used to respect roses.

pocket_pistol.name: Pocket Pistol
pocket_pistol.desc: Small, snub, a little embarrassed to be seen. Still loud.

snub_revolver.name: Snub Revolver
snub_revolver.desc: Five chambers and a mother-of-pearl grip that is trying too hard.

nine_pistol.name: Nine Pistol
nine_pistol.desc: A 9mm that lived in a nightstand. The nightstand did not make it.

ammo_9mm.name: 9mm Round
ammo_9mm.desc: Brass that wants a home. The pistol is picky.

ammo_38.name: .38 Round
ammo_38.desc: Short, stout, a revolver's favorite gossip.

speedloader.name: Speedloader
speedloader.desc: A star of brass waiting for a cylinder.

bandage.name: Bandage
bandage.desc: Clean enough. Wrap tight, pretend you are professional.

antiseptic.name: Antiseptic
antiseptic.desc: Stings like a lecture. The wound will live it down.

painkillers.name: Painkillers
painkillers.desc: A bottle with the name scratched off. The ache steps aside.

antibiotics.name: Antibiotics
antibiotics.desc: A blister pack that outlived its prescription.

first_aid_kit.name: First Aid Kit
first_aid_kit.desc: Gauze, tape, a pair of scissors, and a note that says "be better."

alcohol_wipe.name: Alcohol Wipe
alcohol_wipe.desc: Tiny, sterile, smells like a nurse's pocket.

vitamins.name: Vitamins
vitamins.desc: Day-glo pills. Optimism you can swallow.

sleeping_pills.name: Sleeping Pills
sleeping_pills.desc: The dusk does not do night. These pretend.

gauze_roll.name: Gauze Roll
gauze_roll.desc: Soft, endless, a little too white for this town.

nurse_kit.name: Nurse's Kit
nurse_kit.desc: Pink-trimmed pouch that still smells like antiseptic and cheap perfume.

flashlight.name: Flashlight
flashlight.desc: The beam is a rumor. The handle is a comfort.

can_opener.name: Can Opener
can_opener.desc: The difference between beans and a blunt object.

wrench.name: Wrench
wrench.desc: Adjustable, stubborn, always the wrong size until it isn't.

hand_saw.name: Hand Saw
hand_saw.desc: Teeth that remember lumber. They can remember other things.

duct_tape.name: Duct Tape
duct_tape.desc: Silver promise. Holds fences, feelings, and bad plans.

lighter.name: Lighter
lighter.desc: A click and a little gold. Do not waste it on nerves.

matchbook.name: Matchbook
matchbook.desc: Motel matches. The cover girl is still winking.

coil_rope.name: Coil of Rope
coil_rope.desc: Honest hemp. Climb, bind, or look prepared.

scissors.name: Scissors
scissors.desc: Kitchen shears that have opinions about tape and hair.

gas_can.name: Gas Can
gas_can.desc: Red, dented, a swallow of fuel left. Smells like summer leaving.

lockpick.name: Lockpick
lockpick.desc: A slim steel secret. The town has more doors than keys.

leather_jacket.name: Leather Jacket
leather_jacket.desc: Black, scuffed, still holding someone else's swagger.

work_boots.name: Work Boots
work_boots.desc: Steel toe, mud memory. They walk like they mean it.

rain_poncho.name: Rain Poncho
rain_poncho.desc: Yellow as a warning. The rain never came; the dusk did.

baseball_cap.name: Baseball Cap
baseball_cap.desc: Brim bent, sweat-dark. A little shade, a little attitude.

surgical_mask.name: Surgical Mask
surgical_mask.desc: Paper that pretends to be a boundary.

firefighter_coat.name: Firefighter Coat
firefighter_coat.desc: Heavy, reflective, still smelling of smoke that wasn't yours.

riot_vest.name: Riot Vest
riot_vest.desc: Kevlar with a city seal half-peeled. It does not make you polite.

winter_coat.name: Winter Coat
winter_coat.desc: Too much coat for Clermont. Perfect for a dusk that forgot seasons.

silk_slip.name: Silk Slip
silk_slip.desc: Pale as a motel lamp. It was hanging on a bedroom door like a dare.

lace_choker.name: Lace Choker
lace_choker.desc: Black lace, a tiny heart charm. It sits like a secret.

red_heels.name: Red Heels
red_heels.desc: A statement with a death wish on gravel. You wear them anyway.

sundress.name: Sundress
sundress.desc: Floral, thin, a little too friendly for the ash lots.

ripped_jeans.name: Ripped Jeans
ripped_jeans.desc: The rips were fashion, then accident, then policy.

plain_tee.name: Plain Tee
plain_tee.desc: Soft cotton. It has seen better nights and worse mornings.

empty_can.name: Empty Can
empty_can.desc: Labels gone, insides scraped. Still a kind of treasure.

damp_newspaper.name: Damp Newspaper
damp_newspaper.desc: Hwy 50 scores, a sale that never happened, a name in the obituaries.

broken_radio.name: Broken Radio
broken_radio.desc: It hisses if you shake it. That is not a station.

cigarette_pack.name: Cigarette Pack
cigarette_pack.desc: Three left, crushed. A habit looking for a mouth.

red_lipstick.name: Red Lipstick
red_lipstick.desc: A bullet of color. The last wearer almost finished the point.

compact_mirror.name: Compact Mirror
compact_mirror.desc: Powder and a cracked glass. You still look like trouble.

playing_cards.name: Playing Cards
playing_cards.desc: Sticky, incomplete, the queen of hearts is missing on purpose.

vhs_tape.name: VHS Tape
vhs_tape.desc: Hand-labeled. You will not watch it. You will keep it.

dead_phone.name: Dead Phone
dead_phone.desc: Black mirror, no signal, a lock-screen of someone laughing.

photo_frame.name: Photo Frame
photo_frame.desc: A family on a dock. The water in the picture is brighter.

lucky_bottlecap.name: Lucky Bottlecap
lucky_bottlecap.desc: Someone on US 27 dropped a wish.

board_game.name: Board Game
board_game.desc: Half the pieces, all of the rules, none of the patience.

empty_bottle.name: Empty Bottle
empty_bottle.desc: Glass that used to hold a night.

tv_remote.name: TV Remote
tv_remote.desc: Buttons that still click. The set does not.

house_key.name: House Key
house_key.desc: A brass tooth for a Maple Street lock. Maybe yours now.

shop_key.name: Shop Key
shop_key.desc: Labeled "back room." The front room is already everyone's.

gas_key.name: Pump Key
gas_key.desc: Tiny, red-tagged. The pumps still pretend to listen.

motel_key.name: Motel Key
motel_key.desc: Plastic fob, room 3. The bed is still made. Barely.

rusted_key.name: Rusted Key
rusted_key.desc: It fits something that no longer wants to open.

plastic_bag.name: Plastic Bag
plastic_bag.desc: It will split. You will use it anyway.

duffel_bag.name: Duffel Bag
duffel_bag.desc: Gym-sour and roomy. Someone packed in a hurry.

hiking_backpack.name: Hiking Backpack
hiking_backpack.desc: Hip belt, too many straps, a patch that says TRY ME.

satin_purse.name: Satin Purse
satin_purse.desc: Small, shiny, a lipstick ghost in the lining.

school_backpack.name: School Backpack
school_backpack.desc: Markers in the pocket, a crush in the notes.

gym_bag.name: Gym Bag
gym_bag.desc: Mesh pocket, faint perfume, a lock that is not locked.

pistol.name: Lot Pistol
pistol.desc: A square, unlovely 9mm from the Hancock hut. Loud enough to end an argument.

shotgun.name: Pump Shotgun
shotgun.desc: Short pump, walnut stain, a muzzle that does not do nuance.

ammo.name: Pistol Ammo
ammo.desc: Brass for the lot pistol. Keep it dry. Keep it counted.

ammo_shotgun.name: Shotgun Shell
ammo_shotgun.desc: Red hull, brass head. The pump eats these and nothing else.

angle_grinder.name: angle grinder
angle_grinder.desc: A widespread power tool, often used for removing excess material or polishing surfaces.

claw_bar.name: claw bar
claw_bar.desc: A small prying tool with a clawed bend at one end for pulling spikes.  Use it to open locked doors without destroying them or to lift manhole covers.  You could also wield it to bash some heads in.

cordless_drill.name: cordless drill
cordless_drill.desc: A cordless battery-powered drill with a selection of drill bits.

hacksaw.name: hacksaw
hacksaw.desc: A sturdy saw, useful for cutting through metal objects.

tin_snips.name: tin_snips
tin_snips.desc: A pair of tin snips, resembling a sturdy pair of scissors with beefy blades designed to cut through thin sheets of soft metal.  These cannot cut through thick metals like a hacksaw can, but are better suited to precision work and leave a cl

hammer.name: hammer
hammer.desc: A demagnetized steel claw hammer with a wooden grip.  With a hammer, nails, and planks in your inventory, you could board up adjacent doors and windows.  It has myriad other uses as well.

hand_drill.name: hand drill
hand_drill.desc: A primitive manual drill with a single drill bit.  It is slow to use, and will exhaust you quickly.

hose.name: rubber hose
hose.desc: A flexible rubber hose.  It could be used for crafting or siphoning fuel from a vehicle.

jack.name: bottle jack
jack.desc: A portable hydraulic bottle jack used for lifting vehicles.

jack_small.name: scissor jack
jack_small.desc: A compact scissor jack used for lifting vehicles.

large_repairkit.name: gunsmith repair kit
large_repairkit.desc: A complete tool kit made to repair damaged firearms.  Powered by standard batteries, it is a vital tool for long-term firearms maintenance.  It requires 1 charge of battery power per use.

makeshift_hammer.name: makeshift hammer
makeshift_hammer.desc: A crude hammer made from a piece of metal affixed to a stick.  It functions adequately, but really can't compare to a proper hammer.

misc_repairkit.name: miscellaneous repair kit
misc_repairkit.desc: A portable tool kit consisting of a small craft knife for precise carving of replacement parts from raw materials, a wood saw for more heavy-duty wood cutting, and a patch of soft material for cleaning surfaces.  If supplied with duct tape,

multitool.name: multitool
multitool.desc: A cleverly designed all-in-one tool which combines several smaller tools into the handles of a pair of pliers.

pickaxe.name: pickaxe
pickaxe.desc: A large steel pickaxe, suitable for breaking up hard things or (with enough skill) hard targets.  Strike the earth!

pliers.name: pliers
pliers.desc: A basic pair of slip-joint pliers, able to handle basic mechanical work.  Anything more complex will require a wrench.

screwdriver.name: screwdriver
screwdriver.desc: A Philips-head screwdriver.  It is important for almost all electronics crafting, most mechanics crafting, and has many more uses.

screwdriver_set.name: screwdriver set
screwdriver_set.desc: A set of screwdrivers in several sizes and blade types.  Guaranteed to have the right tools for more precise work.

soldering_iron.name: soldering iron
soldering_iron.desc: A device with a metal tip that can get very hot.  It is necessary for advanced electronics crafting.  Has a short cable that you can plug to your grid.

lug_wrench.name: lug wrench
lug_wrench.desc: A steel rod bent 90 degrees with a socket on the shorter end, made to hold the lug nuts of a car's wheels to either fasten or loosen for convenient removal and replacement.  Makes for a decent melee weapon in a pinch.

welder.name: arc welder
welder.desc: A cable-powered tool for welding metal pieces together using an electric arc.  It is an indispensable tool for construction or repair.

xacto.name: X-Acto knife
xacto.desc: A small, sharp knife, designed for making precise cuts for textiles or crafts.  It could cause decent damage, but is difficult to land a solid hit with.  Its small, sharp blade allows for precision strikes in the hands of the skilled.

wrench_small.name: small adjustable wrench
wrench_small.desc: A compact adjustable crescent wrench, with a short handle that fits in the palm of your hand.  It could be used for turning small hex-head nuts or bolts.

cuban_sandwich.name: Cuban Sandwich
cuban_sandwich.desc: Pressed pork, ham, swiss, pickles, mustard. Hwy 50 food truck classic.

key_lime_empanada.name: Key Lime Empanada
key_lime_empanada.desc: Sweet-tart Florida pastry from a rolling cart.

cafe_con_leche.name: Cafe Con Leche
cafe_con_leche.desc: Hot milk coffee poured from a stainless urn. Wakes the lot.

gator_bites.name: Gator Bites
gator_bites.desc: Fried nuggets that taste like chicken if you do not think about it.

orange_slush.name: Orange Grove Slush
orange_slush.desc: Icy citrus from a truck parked under the power lines.

boiled_peanuts.name: Boiled Peanuts
boiled_peanuts.desc: Salty soft peanuts in a foam cup. Florida gas-station energy.

walmart_water.name: 24pk Water
walmart_water.desc: Bulk bottled water from the big box on the edge of town.

walmart_ammo.name: Sporting Ammo
walmart_ammo.desc: Value-bin 9mm from the far Walmart aisle. Do not ask.

cheap_cooler.name: Foam Cooler
cheap_cooler.desc: Blue foam cooler. Holds shakes and bad decisions.

gator_meat.name: Gator Meat
gator_meat.desc: Fresh from the lake edge. Cook it or dare someone.

gator_hide.name: Gator Hide
gator_hide.desc: Tough scute leather. Somebody downtown will buy it.

aki_mecha_fig.name: Mecha Figure
aki_mecha_fig.blurb: Box-fresh anime mecha from Animate Akihabara.

aki_retro_cart.name: Retro Game Cart
aki_retro_cart.blurb: Dusty cart from Super Potato's glass case.

aki_usb_gadget.name: Odd USB Gadget
aki_usb_gadget.blurb: Radio Kaikan special — blinks for no reason.

pet_kibble.name: Bag of Kibble
pet_kibble.desc: Chicken-flavor dry food. Dogs and desperate lot rats approve.

pet_treats.name: Pet Treats
pet_treats.desc: Soft chews. Somehow edible. +8 HP if you're that hungry.

pet_leash.name: Nylon Leash
pet_leash.desc: Six-foot leash. Also a terrible whip.

pet_goldfish.name: Feeder Goldfish
pet_goldfish.desc: Bagged. Do not flush on Hwy 50.

bb_earbuds.name: Open-Box Earbuds
bb_earbuds.desc: One side quieter. Still beats Mira's neon hum.

gs_preowned.name: Pre-Owned Game
gs_preowned.desc: Case scuffed. Save file belongs to 'xXDarkAlecXx'.

gs_energy.name: GameFuel Can
gs_energy.desc: Tastes like battery acid and XP. +15 HP.

gs_poster.name: Promo Poster
gs_poster.desc: Rolled tight. Michelle would not hang this.

tire_patch_kit.name: Tire Patch Kit
tire_patch_kit.desc: Plug + glue. Cuts tire wear ~40% when applied at Rico's.

tire_set_new.name: New Tire Set
tire_set_new.desc: Four fresh tires. Full reset at Hwy 50 Tire & Lube.

tire_balance.name: Balance & Rotate
tire_balance.desc: Service slip — Rico spins them true. Softens handling penalty.

nail_polish_rose.name: Rose Gel Polish
nail_polish_rose.desc: Sticky rose gel. French tips optional.

nail_polish_french.name: French Tip Kit
nail_polish_french.desc: White tips + nude base. Michelle already owns a set.

pedicure_oil.name: Pedicure Oil
pedicure_oil.desc: Warm oil for soles. Adult lounge only.
